item.description: A study recommended several locations on the moon for future crewed missions, including a farside crater and an Apollo landing site, even as NASA focuses on a south pole base.

item.description: HELSINKI — A commercial Ceres-1 solid rocket launched a pathfinder satellite from the Yellow Sea late Tuesday, kicking off a Guangzhou-backed remote sensing constellation project.

item.title: Sound decisions will enable U.S. crewed lunar landings
item.description: NASA has successfully led off the Artemis human lunar program with the Artemis 1 test flight and the exciting Artemis 2 crewed flight around the moon. These missions demonstrated the United States’ capability to conduct human deep space exploration with the highly proven Space Launch System (SLS) and Orion crew vehicle. It is essential to continue an accelerated mission cadence to reduce risk and validate increasing capabilities on a pace to safely land astronauts on the moon as soon as possible.

item.title: SpaceX launches second Starfall reentry vehicle
item.description: SpaceX launched a rideshare mission Oct. 20 whose payload included the company’s second Starfall reentry vehicle.

item.title: Uzbekistan signs the Artemis Accords
item.description: Uzbekistan signed the Artemis Accords outlining best practices for space exploration on Oct. 19, becoming the 77th country to do so.

item.title: Japan launches sample-return mission to Martian moon Phobos
item.description: Japan has launched an ambitious mission that will be the first to attempt to return samples from a moon of Mars.
